hypothesis: High short interest plus price/event strength may identify squeeze-ready existing Ginger candidates, while high short crowding plus negative event context may identify fragile candidates. This run only checks whether new PIT short/borrow evidence exists after exp-20260503-018.
non_ohlcv_data_source: exchange short interest, FINRA daily short volume, and paid securities-lending / borrow-pressure feeds
single_causal_variable: new PIT-safe short-interest or borrow-pressure evidence since exp-20260503-018

alpha_hypothesis.text: High short crowding plus existing breakout_long/trend_long strength or positive event context may be a squeeze setup tag; high short crowding plus negative filing/news/earnings context may be a fragile-short risk tag.
alpha_hypothesis.why_not_now: The prior audits found no PIT-safe short-interest, FINRA short-volume, or borrow-pressure rows, and this recheck found no new local structured source files.

historical_experiment_check.prior_result_summary: 0 structured short-interest rows, 0 FINRA adapter/files, 0 paid borrow rows, 0 PIT-safe rows, and 0 taggable candidates.

historical_experiment_check.new_evidence_since_prior: No new local files matching structured short interest, FINRA daily short volume, paid borrow, hard-to-borrow, borrow fee, shares available, or squeeze data were found after exp-20260503-018.

bias_notes: Short-interest settlement dates are not tradable without publication dates.
FINRA daily short volume is trading activity, not short positioning.
News/headline mentions are not structured borrow-pressure evidence.
Without borrow_fee or shares_available, squeeze confidence must be downgraded.
